code.title: local_image.py
code.source:
import base64

with open("receipt.jpg", "rb") as f:
    b64 = base64.{{b1}}(f.read()).decode("utf-8")

response = client.responses.create(
    model="my-deployment",
    input=[{"role": "user", "content": [
        {"type": "input_text", "text": "List the items on this receipt."},
        {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{b64}"},
    ]}],
)

exercises.explanation: Una imagen local se envía codificada en base64 dentro de una URL de datos (data:image/jpeg;base64,...). b64decode haría lo contrario.

import base64

result = client.{{b1}}.generate(
    model="my-image-deployment",
    prompt="A watercolor painting of a lighthouse at sunrise",
    size="1024x1024",
    quality="medium",
)
image_bytes = base64.{{b2}}(result.data[0].{{b3}})

with open("lighthouse.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(image_bytes)

code.title: caption.py
code.source:
from azure.ai.vision.imageanalysis import ImageAnalysisClient
from azure.ai.vision.imageanalysis.models import VisualFeatures
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential

client = ImageAnalysisClient(
    endpoint="https://contoso.cognitiveservices.azure.com/",
    credential=AzureKeyCredential("<your-key>"),
)

result = client.{{b1}}(
    image_url="https://contoso.com/photos/street.jpg",
    visual_features=[VisualFeatures.{{b2}}],
)
print(result.caption.text)

exercises.explanation: analyze_from_url recibe una URL pública; la característica CAPTION devuelve una frase en result.caption.

with open("street.jpg", "rb") as f:
    image_data = f.read()

result = client.{{b1}}(image_data=image_data, visual_features=[VisualFeatures.TAGS])
for tag in result.tags.{{b2}}:
    print(tag.name, tag.confidence)

exercises.explanation: analyze recibe los bytes de la imagen; result.tags.list contiene cada etiqueta con su nombre y confianza.
